_evidence: 0x004459b7: 'cmp byte [0x7a8df8],0xff; jne' (exit), 'and [0x62f8fe], [0x62f8fd]', 'test byte [0x62f8ed],0x40; je', then 'movzx eax, byte [0x62f8ea]; bts dword [0x62f8e0], eax' - a register bit offset addresses dword [0x62f8e0 + (eax>>5)*4], so an index byte 0..255 sets a bit in 0x62f8e0..0x62f8ff (the same block holds the other bytes). All of these are run-time network-state bytes (0x445a59/0x445b9a/0x445c3c write them), only compared, and-ed or bit-set: every value is valid and bts cannot leave the 32-byte block. The block's dwords are random first, then the selector draws 0xff in half the picks, bit 6 of 0x62f8ed is random and the index byte 0x62f8ea any of 0..255 (later fields override the dword background).
